Source-only integration; no imports, tests, builds, package installs, servers or model execution performed by worker A.
Patch order: P1 then P2 for session.py; P3 then P5 for speaker_prompt.py; P4 for X-Voice CUDA/local assets; P6 for loopback/health/headless backend. Intermediate source-text baselines are review artifacts, not imported code.
P1: 1-based per-session seg_uid, complete source spans on enqueue/outcome; terminal translation/tts/empty failures; success includes raw PCM16 mono tts_bytes/tts_sha256/tts_sample_rate followed by exactly one binary frame under a wire lock.
P2: source audio first passes the original speaker tracker and all boundary-flush events, then enters ASR. All ASR samples are processed without upstream backlog dropping. Bounded ingress/pending queues provide backpressure. Actual processed counters control timing. xt_barrier/through_ms returns barrier_done with frontier_ms,processed_audio_ms,max_enqueued_uid only after speaker marker, ASR consumption and terminal queue drain; drain aliases remain supported. Open turn frontier is conservative turn start. A barrier does not finalize/reset the original ASR or speaker buckets.
P3/P5: CAM++ explicitly CUDA with actual parameter checks; no spectral fallback on provider choice, initialization or inference errors.
P4: X-Voice explicit CUDA with XVoice/Vocos/SpeedPredictor parameter checks, provisioned local Vocos; fixed-language stage2 skips unconditional fastlid import. DeepFilterNet is explicitly disabled because prompts already come from Demucs. Actual tokenizer/text normalizer code remains.
Runtime ownership: XTServices(config,lease_source).ensure(owner) explicitly starts Ubuntu-24.04 only. Four endpoints bind127.0.0.1; all ports are reserved before model startup and readiness requires an owned LISTEN socket inode. Linux supervisor owns session/process groups, run-token tags and /proc starttime identities, adopts orphan descendants and enforces heartbeat+3072MiB GPU floor. Windows lease held until Linux/proc and GPU cleanup confirmed. No wsl --shutdown/--terminate, no Sem-Unreal access. Resource restart allowed only after confirmed cleanup. Fatal/uncertain cleanup fails closed.
Runtime offline: HF/ModelScope offline flags, private sitecustomize external socket/DNS/install guard, loopback VLLM interfaces. Backend logs/session audio/temp files use owned run directory. Missing assets are failures; no hidden model fetch.
Configuration fields: xt_wsl_distro,xt_python,xt_asr_python,xt_mt_python,xt_tts_python,xt_vendor_dir,xt_asr_model,xt_mt_model,xt_xvoice_ckpt,xt_rate_ckpt,xt_vocab,xt_vocos_dir,xt_campplus_model,xt_espeak_library,xt_espeak_data,xt_asr_port,xt_mt_port,xt_tts_port,xt_app_port,xt_asr_gpu_memory_utilization,xt_mt_gpu_memory_utilization,xt_start_timeout_seconds,xt_idle_seconds. Python/model/espeak paths are Linux absolute; vendor/state are Windows local-drive paths mapped to /mnt/. Default ASR/MT fractions .15/.54 are configuration only, not proof of fit.
Known limits: Linux package/model compatibility, runtime CUDA parameter layouts, WSL forwarding, real VAD/ASR/MT/speaker/TTS quality, memory fit and cancellation/cleanup runtime behavior remain unexecuted. Code inspection is not runtime evidence. Root provisions environments/models and owns later explicitly approved execution.
R52 updates: barrier budget is120s NO REAL PROCESSING PROGRESS, with hard xt_request_timeout_seconds (default900) overall cap. xt_progress counters reflect completed speaker/ASR work and delivered terminal outcomes only. Qwen feed/finalize run in the existing ASR task's awaited thread so the event loop can enforce its deadline. Only typed transport failures or explicit barrier stall/deadline get stage-tagged resource/recoverable errors; schema/config/CUDA errors are not relabeled transport. Root/client own bounded3session recovery.
Startup now requires xt_model_manifest andxt_runtime_receipt. Windows checksmanifestsha againstprovisioningreceipt; Linux streams/hash-checks every recordedfile/size andexactfileset, andbindseachconfiguredQwen/LMT/XVoice/SRP/vocab/Vocos/CAMpath toitsprovisionedrecord BEFOREloadinganymodel. Hashing is boundedby startupdeadline and periodicallychecksheartbeat/GPUfloor. No modelstate is loadedbyverification.
R52 runtime-requirements.txt/runtime-constraints.txt replace vendor project dependency resolution. Runtime code remains on PYTHONPATH; P7 makes unusedtrainer exports lazy. Actual installation,pipcheck andallmodel/runtime behavior remainunexecutedbyworkerA.
R55/P8 supersedes the old .15/.54 fixed fractions: fixed KV ASR1024MiB/MT768MiB with BF16,eager,one sequence andbatchedtokens=maxlen8192/4096. Startup fractionsarederivedfrommanifestweights+KV+1024MiBoverhead, roundedup0.01,sum<=.80. Windowsfreshfree admission includesXVoice2048,CAM256,additionalDemucsgrowth0and3072floor; warmedhelperresidencyisnotcountedtwice. LinuxrechecksactualsameGPUfreshfreebeforeeachvLLMlaunch. Typedbudgetfailuresarefatalwithoutautomaticretry. SeeP8-BUDGET.txt; no runtimefit claim.
